channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Luol Deng | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Luol Deng from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Carmelo Anthony, Luol Deng
item.description:
“I didn't know how good he would become. I think his first year was the lockout year; he was playing behind Luol Deng, really the first opportunity he had to play was here at the Garden. It was midway [through the season], Luol was out, he had to guard Melo [Carmelo Anthony]. And he came in -- I was talking to the coaches before the game, I said, 'Are we really playing him? First game [here]?' And he was great. And that told me a lot about him right there. And then each year he just got better and better.”

Tom Thibodeau on Carmelo Anthony, Luol Deng, May 6, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Luol Deng, Derrick Rose, Saddiq Bey
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on Saddiq:

“I see him as a Luol Deng-type, that's who Derrick told me he reminded me of.”

Dwane Casey on Luol Deng, Derrick Rose, Saddiq Bey, Jan 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Luol Deng
item.description:
Butler on Luol Deng's night:

“I wish I could’ve been here. Lu taught me so much about the game and being a pro. I was very fortunate to be able to learn from him. He’s just an incredible, incredible human being. I’m glad he got to go out here. He did a lot for this organization.”

Jimmy Butler on Luol Deng, Nov 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, Luol Deng, Joe Johnson
item.description:
“You know when you come to a new team it’s hard to find your spot at first. We had (Chris Bosh) at first, we had D-Wade, Joe Johnson, Luol Deng; there were a lot of players they were good and you just need time to adjust and fit into the system.“You could see the last year together we demonstrated we can play together.”

Goran Dragic on Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, Luol Deng, Joe Johnson, Feb 13, 2018. Source: Palm Beach Post.

item.title: Josh Richardson on Luol Deng
item.description:
Josh Richardson:

“It was probably sitting next to Luol Deng in the locker room. He was my vet and I was his rook, so we were real close. He was a great guy and being able to learn from him my whole first year was huge for me.”

Josh Richardson on Luol Deng, Jun 17, 2017. Source: Oklahoman.

item.title: Pat Riley on Luol Deng
item.description:
Jason Lieser:Riley on Luol Deng:

“When Lu told us he was getting $72M, there was no way-- That train left the station.”

Pat Riley on Luol Deng, Jul 16, 2016. Source: Twitter @JasonLieser.

item.title: Pat Riley on Luol Deng
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:Pat Riley on Luol Deng:

“I consider him one of our core people. And we've got to do everything we can to keep him.”

Pat Riley on Luol Deng, May 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Pat Riley on Dwyane Wade, Luol Deng
item.description:
Jason Lieser:Pat Riley on Wade & Deng:

“We have not received any information (about the player option for 2015-16).”

Pat Riley on Dwyane Wade, Luol Deng, Jun 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @PBPjasonlieser.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Luol Deng
item.description:
Jason Lieser:Wade on Deng (ill):

“I told him if he's not playing I'm not playing, so it was good to see him in here tonight.”

Dwyane Wade on Luol Deng, Jan 20, 2015. Source: Twitter @PBPjasonlieser.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Luol Deng
item.description:
Jason Lieser:Tom Thibodeau on Deng:

“I can't say enough about Lu. He gave us everything he had.”

Tom Thibodeau on Luol Deng, Dec 14, 2014. Source: Twitter @PBPjasonlieser.

item.title: Danny Ferry on Luol Deng
item.description:
The following statement was released by President of Basketball Operations/General ManagerDanny Ferry:

“No words can adequately describe my remorse for the hurt that I have caused many people through the statements I repeated, most importantly Luol Deng. Luol is a good man who I have known for many years and he has done a tremendous amount of good for his country and around the world. I apologize to Luol and I apologize to all that I have offended. As I have said, while these were not my words, I deeply regret repeating them.”

Danny Ferry on Luol Deng, Sep 12, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Pat Riley on Luol Deng
item.description:
“Signing Luol Deng is one of the most important free agent signings that we have ever had in the history of the franchise,”

Pat Riley on Luol Deng, Jul 15, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Joakim Noah on Luol Deng
item.description:
KC Johnson:Noah on facing Luol Deng on Wednesday:

“It’ll probably be weird. But I still want to kick his ass right now.”

Joakim Noah on Luol Deng, Jan 21, 2014. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Anthony Bennett on Luol Deng
item.description:
While the trade will certainly limit Bennett’s minutes at small forward, the scout believes it could ultimately benefit him.

“I think trading for Deng can really be a positive thing for Bennett in the long run,”

Anthony Bennett on Luol Deng, Jan 9, 2014. Source: SheridanHoops.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Luol Deng
item.description:
KC Johnson:Thibodeau on Deng:

“Obviously, he wants to be here. He has to get better first. He has to prioritize his health.”

Tom Thibodeau on Luol Deng, May 15, 2013. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Luol Deng
item.description:
KC Johnson:Thibodeau on Deng:

“He's one of the most underrated players in the league. He does so much without the ball. He's in constant motion.”

Tom Thibodeau on Luol Deng, Jun 23, 2010. Source: Twitter.
